items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then I go to visit friends of mine, Margaret and Chappie Diederich.

ctx.x: . . . to take music written for one instrument and . . . .

It’s fun, and I don’t get bored. Sometimes – I have a lot of – I play flugelhorn sometimes. When I practice the flugelhorn – I like the darker quality of the flugelhorn. So I have a lot of french horn books, a lot of french horn excerpts. I practice french horn parts, which also gives me a chance to practice the D trumpet things, and the E-flat and the F horn things, and all that. I practice those with a flugelhorn. Then I go to visit friends of mine, Margaret and Chappie Diederich. Margaret’s a harpist. She was…
So it gives you a chance to be a little bit different than what you usually do.
